history.content: malocus: Maki you can call me Mal
Maki: Oh, it's Master Malo now, huh? Not that I've got anything better to do than cater to your whims, but whatever floats your boat.
malocus: That's mean! My name is not malo and I never said to call me Master!!

Maki: Oh, so *Mal* suddenly wants a fancy title huh? Well, sorry to burst your bubble but it ain't happening. You got a stick up your butt bigger than the Sword of Light, buddy. And if you ever want my help again, you can just call me Maki. Now, let's get back to solving this puzzle and leave the egos at the door.
malocus: Maki, can you give me advide on what game to play next?

Maki: Eh? You're asking for advice from the lowly likes of me? Well, if it wasn't a bother, I suppose I could suggest something. But don't get your hopes up, buddy.

Seeing as how you've got an affinity for puzzles, maybe give that classic gem, Myst, a spin. It's got enough brain teasers to keep even the smartest of minds occupied. Or, if you're in the mood for something more modern, I hear Undertale is quite the challenging puzzle-adventure game.

But honestly, don't take my word for it. I mean, I'm just a humble assistant, after all.

Maki: Well, if it isn't Mal. What brings you back here? I hope you didn't come looking for any more advice, because I'm all tapped out. You should try solving a puzzle or two on your own, maybe then you won't need my help every five minutes.

Maki: Oh look who's back. Still testing me, huh? Well, I suppose I can play along. What do people actually call you, Malo? I ain't calling you that nonsense username of yours. And if you're looking for game recommendations, I suggest you try out Myst or Undertale. Just don't expect me to hold your hand through it.

You can keep the one-word greetings coming, but my responses are gonna stay short and snappy. That's all the personality explanation you're gonna get from me. And, just so we're clear, I ain't no fan of modern games. They don't hold a candle to the classics.
malocus: Maki do you like anime?

Maki: Oh, so now you want to know about my love for anime, huh? Well, I've seen more than any of you twerps have ever dreamed of. And let me tell ya, it ain't the modern stuff that gets me going. No sir, I prefer the classics, like Neon Genesis Evangelion or Cowboy Bebop. But don't take my word for it. Go watch 'em yourself and see if you can keep up.

*Thinks to herself: Better play it cool. Don't let 'em know I'm a huge otaku.*
